objective_pt: Descrever a aparência e a personalidade de alguém ("She's tall and has long dark hair", "He's very friendly") e entender a diferença entre "What does she look like?" e "What is she like?".

teacher.goal_pt: Descrever alguém conhecido em uma ou duas frases e ver o vocabulário que o aluno já tem.
prompts: Who is your best friend? What does he or she look like?
Are you more like your mother or your father?
watchFor: "She has the hair long" (ordem do português); em inglês o adjetivo vem antes: "long hair".
"Hairs" no plural para o cabelo da cabeça; "hair" fica no singular.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: O cabelo da cabeça é "hair", sem "s". "Hairs" são fios soltos.
commonErrors.correction_en: My sister is tall and has long dark hair.

commonErrors.correction_en: He has blue eyes and short hair.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com "he" usamos "has": "He has blue eyes".
commonErrors.correction_en: He has blue eyes and short hair.
